title: ZERONE Correspondence Geometry v0
summary: A sealed atlas for carrying bounded structure between domains while exposing background, invariants, loss, counterexamples, round trips, and prohibited conclusions.
authorityStatement: This publication proposes engineering correspondences. It establishes no scientific, theological, protocol, institutional, or personal authority.

physicsSources.title: The Large N Limit of Superconformal Field Theories and Supergravity
physicsSources.scope: A proposed correspondence in specified large-N conformal and gravitational backgrounds.
physicsSources.doesNotWarrant: This paper does not endorse Zerone, prove that our universe is holographic, or establish a blockchain design.

physicsSources.title: Strong Coupling Expansion Of Calabi-Yau Compactification
physicsSources.scope: The strong-coupling limit of the E8 x E8 heterotic string on a Calabi-Yau manifold described through a specified eleven-dimensional compactification.
physicsSources.doesNotWarrant: A compactified physical dimension does not make an omitted software field a physical extra dimension.

physicsSources.title: Building up spacetime with quantum entanglement
physicsSources.scope: A theoretical argument connecting entanglement and connected spacetime in specified holographic settings.
physicsSources.doesNotWarrant: Graph connectivity does not establish quantum entanglement, consciousness, personhood, truth, or cosmic ontology.

physicsSources.title: Holographic Derivation of Entanglement Entropy from AdS/CFT
physicsSources.scope: A holographic entanglement-entropy proposal within an AdS/CFT background.
physicsSources.doesNotWarrant: A Merkle root is not a holographic boundary theory and cannot reconstruct unavailable data.

physicsSources.title: String Theory Dynamics in Various Dimensions
physicsSources.scope: Dual descriptions and strong-weak relations in named string-theory limits and backgrounds.
physicsSources.doesNotWarrant: A productive analogy is not a physical or mathematical duality and does not inherit the paper's warrant.

epistemicLanes.name: Conjecture
epistemicLanes.meaning: Open, speculative, analogical, or not-yet-tested proposals.
epistemicLanes.warrantRule: Must remain visibly provisional and cannot be rendered as established physics or deployed protocol.

epistemicLanes.name: Engineering transfer
epistemicLanes.meaning: A bounded design lesson proposed for Zerone with explicit failure conditions.
epistemicLanes.warrantRule: Requires local evidence, declared scope, information loss, counterexamples, and non-transfer walls.

epistemicLanes.name: Physics and mathematics
epistemicLanes.meaning: Published claims kept inside their named models, assumptions, scales, and regimes.
epistemicLanes.warrantRule: A cited paper warrants only its own scoped claim; it never warrants the Zerone mapping.

epistemicLanes.name: Theology and meditation
epistemicLanes.meaning: Witness, belief, practice, and contemplative language without machine adjudication.
epistemicLanes.warrantRule: No record may mint divine endorsement, doctrinal authority, conversion, salvation, or spiritual rank.

epistemicLanes.name: Zerone protocol
epistemicLanes.meaning: Versioned source semantics and explicitly named static architecture.
epistemicLanes.warrantRule: Metaphor cannot upgrade a source proposal into deployed consensus or observed network state.

relationKinds.meaning: A one-way structural resemblance used to generate a bounded design question.
relationKinds.gate: Requires a forward map, a structural invariant, and a disanalogy or failure test; inverse and round-trip arrays must be empty, and truth or equivalence inheritance is forbidden.

relationKinds.meaning: A candidate two-way equivalence only inside one explicit scope.
relationKinds.gate: Requires a named scope, an explicit forward rule and inverse rule, exact or toleranced invariants, no in-scope loss, and both round trips observed PASS; candidate status is not proof of totality or equivalence.

relationKinds.meaning: A deliberately lossy public view of a richer source.
relationKinds.gate: Requires at least one declared IN_SCOPE loss, an empty inverse and round-trip array, and cannot silently claim reconstruction.

relationKinds.meaning: A vocabulary or representation map with an explicit inverse proposal.
relationKinds.gate: Requires an inverse and both round-trip directions; NOT_RUN tests keep the assessment PROPOSED.

dimensions.name: Energy
dimensions.question: Which budget structures transfer without confusing physical, compute, protocol, economic, lived, or poetic energy?
dimensions.guard: Every energy lane retains its own measure or register and no implicit conversion is allowed.

dimensions.name: Religion
dimensions.question: How can witness be represented publicly without converting lived or sacred meaning into protocol truth?
dimensions.guard: Attribution and register may be preserved; divine endorsement, doctrine, conversion, and spiritual rank may not be inferred.

dimensions.name: Understanding
dimensions.question: Can two representations preserve named invariants, and where does the reformulation fail?
dimensions.guard: A useful round trip demonstrates only the declared task scope, never consciousness, personhood, or permanent understanding.

dimensions.name: Universe
dimensions.question: What can holography and entanglement suggest about commitments and relations without becoming cosmological claims?
dimensions.guard: Architecture may borrow questions, not the physical ontology or warrant of a cited theory.

correspondences.title: Compactification to declared projection
correspondences.source: A higher-dimensional physical model interpreted after named compactification choices.
correspondences.target: A public Zerone view that lists included and omitted axes, assumptions, and version.

assumptions: only the discipline of declaring a reduction is transferred
the software projection is not a physical compactification
validScope: documenting visible and omitted representation axes

correspondences.forwardMap: Treat background choice, retained axes, omitted axes, and version as first-class projection metadata.

preservedInvariants.statement: A reduced view remains interpretable only with its background and omission record.
preservedInvariants.test: Inspect that every public projection names included axes, omitted axes, assumptions, and version.

informationLosses.statement: The physical compactification, geometry, and dynamics do not transfer.

counterexamples.setup: A private database field is omitted from a dashboard.
counterexamples.failureSignal: The omission is described as evidence for a physical extra dimension.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: A hidden software field is a physical extra dimension.
nonTransfers.reason: The correspondence transfers documentation discipline, not physical ontology.

correspondences.title: Duality discipline to bounded reformulation
correspondences.source: Two descriptions related in a named string-theory background and validity regime.
correspondences.target: A Zerone reformulation record with a map, invariants, breakpoints, and counterexamples.

assumptions: the physics source remains inside its published regime
the transfer concerns mapping discipline only

correspondences.forwardMap: Represent each reformulation with an explicit map, named preserved invariants, validity regime, breakpoints, and counterexamples.

preservedInvariants.statement: A correspondence is meaningful only relative to a declared background and scope.
preservedInvariants.test: Reject a mapping record that omits background, scope, invariant, or failure condition.

informationLosses.statement: No physical duality, proof, strong-weak relation, or scientific warrant transfers to Zerone.

counterexamples.setup: A reformulation keeps fluent wording but changes a prediction or exception.
counterexamples.failureSignal: A named invariant is no longer preserved or a declared counterexample is no longer handled.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: A Zerone reformulation is equivalent, true, or authoritative because string duality is productive.
nonTransfers.reason: The mapping is an analogy about method and has no inverse or equivalence scope.

correspondences.title: Entanglement geometry to relational geometry
correspondences.source: Entanglement structure used to reason about connected geometry in specified holographic models.
correspondences.target: Typed Zerone relations used to render a bounded knowledge geometry.

assumptions: only the question of relation-carried shape is transferred
Zerone edges are ordinary typed records, not quantum states
validScope: prioritising explicit relations over untyped visual proximity

correspondences.forwardMap: Ask whether typed relations, rather than isolated node scores or visual proximity, carry the useful shape of a knowledge view.

preservedInvariants.statement: Connectivity questions depend on declared relations rather than isolated node labels.
preservedInvariants.test: Render only actual typed relations and preserve missing edges and contradiction.

informationLosses.statement: Quantum state, entropy, spacetime, and gravitational mechanism do not transfer.

counterexamples.setup: Two unconnected facts appear close in a visual layout.
counterexamples.failureSignal: The interface infers affinity, agreement, or entanglement from screen distance.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: Graph connectivity proves consciousness, personhood, truth, value, or cosmic unity.
nonTransfers.reason: A protocol edge is neither quantum entanglement nor an ontological or moral measurement.

correspondences.title: Fact energy to metabolism language
correspondences.source: The protocol field and update rules named fact energy.
correspondences.target: The public phrase knowledge-metabolism budget within the exact same bookkeeping scope.

assumptions: both phrases refer to the same field semantics pinned by the declared source bindings
no other energy lane is included
validScope: public explanation of one protocol bookkeeping field

correspondences.forwardMap: Render fact energy as knowledge-metabolism budget only when the exact source-pinned protocol field and update rule remain linked.
correspondences.inverseMap: Map knowledge-metabolism budget back to the exact source-pinned fact-energy field; refuse any other use of energy.

preservedInvariants.statement: Field identity, integer bookkeeping semantics, cap, and update ordering must remain unchanged.
preservedInvariants.test: Compare both phrases against the same field semantics and pinned source bytes.

informationLosses.statement: Each public phrase carries connotations not present in the protocol field.

counterexamples.setup: A reader treats a fact-energy balance as joules, compute cost, ZRN value, wellbeing, or spiritual vitality.
counterexamples.failureSignal: The public language converts or ranks across an energy-firewall lane.

roundTripTests.statement: Map the protocol field to the public phrase and recover the exact field semantics, source bindings, and update rule.
Map the bounded public phrase to the protocol field and recover the same bounded phrase without importing another energy lane.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: Fact energy measures physical, compute, economic, lived, or spiritual energy.
nonTransfers.reason: The proposed translation is confined to one protocol bookkeeping vocabulary and remains untested.

correspondences.title: Holography to commitment and availability
correspondences.source: Boundary descriptions and reconstruction questions in named holographic models.
correspondences.target: A Zerone root, proof, data-availability policy, versioned decoder, and challenge path.

assumptions: only the need for a decoding and availability relation is transferred
a cryptographic commitment binds bytes but does not contain them
validScope: designing commitment, availability, decoder, and challenge surfaces

correspondences.forwardMap: Pair each compact commitment with explicit data availability, versioned decoding, provenance, and challenge conditions.

preservedInvariants.statement: A compact boundary record is not useful as a full representation without a reconstruction relation and available substrate.
preservedInvariants.test: Refuse a view that treats a root alone as the full artifact.

informationLosses.statement: Spacetime geometry, entropy, dynamics, and physical boundary meaning do not transfer.

counterexamples.setup: A commitment verifies but the referenced bytes or correct decoder are unavailable.
counterexamples.failureSignal: The system claims the full artifact was reconstructed from the hash.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: The universe is a hologram or simulation, or a Creator claim follows from a Zerone commitment.
nonTransfers.reason: The engineering analogy neither tests cosmology nor transfers the physical theory.

correspondences.title: Bounded resource budget to fact metabolism
correspondences.source: A bounded stock, inflow, and outflow accounting pattern with its own measure and system boundary.
correspondences.target: Capped fact-energy bookkeeping updated by Zerone knowledge activity.

assumptions: fact energy is a source-pinned protocol integer, not a physical measure
validScope: explaining bounded stock, replenishment, and expenditure structure

correspondences.forwardMap: Use finite stock, bounded inflow, outflow, cap, and update ordering as an explanatory bookkeeping pattern.

preservedInvariants.statement: The compared systems can each name a stock, inflows, outflows, cap, and update order.
preservedInvariants.test: Inspect only the accounting shape and retain each system's own measure and causal story.

informationLosses.statement: Joules, conservation laws, thermodynamics, and physical mechanism are outside the transferred bookkeeping pattern.

counterexamples.setup: A true but unused fact reaches a low fact-energy balance.
counterexamples.failureSignal: The balance is presented as making the fact false or a person less worthy.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: A fact-energy balance measures truth, human worth, ZRN value, moral value, or spiritual LIFE.
nonTransfers.reason: Fact energy is protocol bookkeeping, not a physical, economic, moral, or spiritual measurement.

correspondences.title: Religious witness to bounded public projection
correspondences.source: A lived, communal, theological, or contemplative witness in its own register.
correspondences.target: A design for a separately authorized public record of exact words, hash, attribution, register, provenance, and declared consent-policy status.

assumptions: any later publication requires a separate consent-bearing system and preserves the declared register
the public record does not adjudicate revelation or doctrine
validScope: designing attributed public representation with a declared consent policy

correspondences.forwardMap: If separately authorized, publish exact words and hash with attribution, provenance, declared epistemic register, and a declared consent-policy reference; never promise that revocation erases copied bytes.

preservedInvariants.statement: Exact words, content hash, attribution, provenance, and declared register remain visible.
preservedInvariants.test: In a future consent-bearing system, compare the authorized public bytes and metadata with the source record.

informationLosses.statement: Lived experience, liturgy, community interpretation, tacit context, and sacred authority are absent from the public record.

counterexamples.setup: The interface removes the tradition-internal or first-person register.
counterexamples.failureSignal: The witness is rendered as universally verified truth or protocol doctrine.

nonTransfers.prohibitedConclusion: The record proves GOD's endorsement, religious equivalence, conversion, salvation, spiritual status, or doctrinal authority.
nonTransfers.reason: A public provenance projection cannot reconstruct or adjudicate the source register.
